items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 144:1
items.html: (To the question) Hesed means the Mochin of AB, when a wall is made for ZA from Hassadim and a wall for the Nukva from Gevurot, and then they separate from one another into two distinct Partzufim. See above, Answer 67, where this is explained at length. (Item 181).
